paper.title: Development of a tenability-based path planning model for building fire evacuations using reinforcement learning

paper.original_data_statement: Data will be made available on request. PDF page 17.

reproduction_level: Independent method reimplementation on the original small-map topology; controlled synthetic FER, not the original FDS scenario and not an exact numeric result reproduction.
topology_source: PDF p8 Fig3: 20 corridor cells; Exit A above R1, Exit B above R20, Room A above R18, Room B below R14; 24 traversable cells. Route lengths 15 and 8 verified against p8-9.

paper_settings.state: 24-cell position one-hot only, as paper eq1 and Table2; elapsed time, cumulative dose and visit history affect transitions/reward but are not observed.
paper_settings.training_starts: Fixed Room B and fixed evacuation start time for each separately trained case.

explicit_implementation_assumptions.loss: MSE per paper eq9, not the SmoothL1 default used by some DQN libraries
explicit_implementation_assumptions.tox_sampling: Left-endpoint rate at the pre-action cell and absolute fire time, times exact 2/0.3 seconds. Linear interpolation of the stored per-second FER grid.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.utility_timing: Use cumulative personal FED including the current step's dose when selecting utility; the original paper does not state code-level ordering.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.revisit_handling: One exclusive path reward: invalid > exit > visited > regular. Invalid remains in place but time and dose advance. Initial state marked visited.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.termination: Exit ends episode. FED>=1 is penalized but does not terminate, consistent with having a severe utility. Step cap is terminal for this finite-horizon implementation.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.DA: Appendix A: at evacuation start, integrate each stationary node's FER from fire ignition to tau; incident edges blocked for FED>=0.3. One shortest path then followed without replanning.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.additional_oracle: Time-expanded minimum-personal-FED dynamic programming with full future synthetic rates; diagnostic lower bound, not a fair real-time information baseline.

controlled_hazard.formula: FER(node,t)=min((t/253)^2,1)*(background + source_rate*exp(-0.5*((corridor_x-17)/sigma(t))^2)); sigma(t)=1.5+0.003*min(t,650). Exits have rate0; RoomA multiplier1.2; RoomB same x-dependent rate. This is a designed proxy, not gas physics.

evaluation: Final policy of each of three training seeds, without selecting a best seed/checkpoint, on the fixed Room B trajectory. Also evaluate each final policy from all 22 non-exit cells as a descriptive coverage diagnostic; identical training scenario, not independent generalization.
scope_limits: No crowd, congestion, LLM, behavior calibration, live sensor response, new building validation or real fire safety claim. Position-only state is not a complete Markov representation when time, personal FED and visit history differ.
exact_reproduction_missing: Per-node CO/HCN/CO2 or FER time series
V/D gas-dose parameters and concentration units
